principle: fail-closed; no prefix-wide tariff unless exact current scope is proven

DEAEW.finding: Albwerk publishes an ENERGIE TO GO card price sheet with own-station AC/DC pricing and time fees, but the available official PDF contains older effective dates and is a registered-card product. The canonical prefix also includes several non-Albwerk site operators. This is not sufficient evidence for a current DEAEW-wide ad-hoc tariff.
DEAEW.neededToComplete: Resolve current public ad-hoc/QR pricing per DEAEW site/EVSE, and separately validate any current ENERGIE TO GO registered-card tariff and time fee.

operators: NEW Niederrhein Energie und Wasser GmbH
DENEW.finding: NEW officially states registered customers pay from 0.47 EUR/kWh depending on charging power, unregistered credit-card users pay a higher price also depending on charging power, and blocking fees vary by normal/fast/ultra-fast class. The complete exact public price matrix is not exposed in retrievable text, so no amount is extrapolated.
DENEW.neededToComplete: Capture the exact current registered and unregistered credit-card tariff matrix by power class plus blocking-fee amounts/conditions, then map to each DENEW EVSE/site.

DEWWL.finding: WWL has a public EVSE checkout surface. A verified example DE*WWL*E99100*04 shows 0.55 EUR/kWh AC with 0.10 EUR/min blocking fee after 3 hours, capped at 17.85 EUR. Other current station observations differ, proving that prefix-wide extrapolation is unsafe.
DEWWL.neededToComplete: Enumerate all DEWWL EVSE IDs through the public checkout and store each exact energy price, minimum amount, blocking threshold/rate/cap and validity.

DEMVV.finding: MVV officially publishes its eMotion registered tariffs (Classic/Plus) by AC/DC and a Fair-Use fee, and states the applicable price is shown in the eMotion app before charging. This does not establish one direct/ad-hoc tariff for every DEMVV EVSE; the prefix also contains several physical operators.
DEMVV.neededToComplete: Resolve exact public/direct pricing per DEMVV EVSE and distinguish it from eMotion Classic/Plus subscriber/app pricing and roaming, preserving Fair-Use rules.
